'''Mandi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] hailing from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. A [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] affiliated with the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]], Mandi was active during the Sorority's conflict with the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Living on Saleucami during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Mandi Served as the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of the [[Revah]], the body-double for the [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]]. Mandi was the only member of the Sorority on Saleucami to know that Revah was not really their leader. An ambitious woman, Mandi hoped to see Revah captured by the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zan Consortium]] so that she could claim the mask for herself. Giving away vital information to a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] fence named [[Krezo Wasanti]], Mandi planned to allow Revah's capture. Mandi carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]], while wearing laminate armor for her own protection. She often draped a rust-red cape over her shoulders and had a scar over her right eye.<ref name="MPQ" />
